assets.name: cover-editorial-v2.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: FINISHED PROFESSIONAL A4 PORTRAIT ACADEMIC REPORT COVER, high resolution, portrait approximately 1:1.414. Create the entire designed cover as one polished editorial image, including carefully typeset text. Original mid-century scientific editorial illustration with tactile lithographic grain, cut-paper shapes, restrained printmaking, sophisticated flat ink textures. Pale ice-blue paper, deep navy #173A5E, slate blue, scientific teal #2E6F73, small muted coral #A95542 accents. No gradients, no photorealism, no glow, no stock graphics, no university logo.
Subject: conformational diversity of an intrinsically disordered peptide studied computationally. The central and lower-middle 50% is a beautiful sculptural composition of several independent loosely folded ribbon-like chains, each visibly continuous and open-ended, suspended over overlapping translucent paper planes and gently curving carved strata. A few elegant coral ribbons contrast with navy and teal ribbons. Shapes convey ensemble diversity and scientific observation as a visual metaphor; they are NOT atomic molecular models, DNA, fibrils, or measured structures. No microscope because the report is computational. No arrows, no nodes, no axes, no chart, no flow diagram. Strong coherent silhouette, delicate stippled shadows, ample breathing space. Adult scientific magazine illustration, not classroom clipart.
Typography: impeccably legible scholarly typography in dark navy; generous margins; small institutional line at top, large title upper third, subtitle below, understated author block below artwork. The illustration must feel integrated across the page rather than placed in a rectangular box.
Use exactly these text strings, with correct diacritics, and no other text:
top: "UNIVERSITY OF MESSINA"
under it: "Data Analysis L-31"
small category: "CURRICULAR INTERNSHIP REPORT"
large title: "RobustCluster-Aβ"
subtitle on 2 lines: "Reproducible analysis of" / "amyloid-β40 conformational descriptors"
small subtitle: "Scientific code audit, sampling diagnostics" / "and feature-space sensitivity"
author block: "Ali Erkan Ocaklı" / "Matricola 555012"
contact block: "Internship contacts" / "Andrea Ciccolo · Valeria Conti Nibali"
bottom: "Academic year 2025–2026"
Prioritize cover balance, typesetting accuracy and an arresting original artistic concept. No extra labels, formulas, logos or invented results.

assets.name: ensemble-editorial-v2.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: wide editorial illustration for an undergraduate computational biology report, landscape 2:1. Original hand-crafted mid-century science editorial artwork, cut-paper collage and tactile lithographic grain on pale ice-blue paper, navy #173A5E, slate blue, teal #2E6F73 and small muted rust coral accents. Image entirely without text.
Subject: the idea of a conformational ensemble of an intrinsically disordered peptide. An elegant still-life of five separate open-ended paper ribbons with visibly different degrees of loose extension and compact curling, floating at different depths above a flat paper surface. Every ribbon is individually continuous with two ends, not attached to another. Some are navy, others teal, one coral. They should look like sculptural artist's paper ribbons, NOT atomistic structures or realistic protein secondary structure assignments. A faint delicate stippled envelope around one ribbon suggests the surrounding solvent, but do not draw solvent molecules. Strong spacious artistic composition, artful asymmetry, dimensional overlapping planes, quiet editorial sophistication, no gradients. Avoid arrows, boxes, labels, molecules, atoms, DNA, fibrils, charts, plots, flow diagrams, glossy 3D. This is a conceptual illustration of diversity, not a result or a reconstruction. Make it beautiful enough for a scientific magazine feature opening.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: wide editorial artwork for a scientific report's well-tempered-metadynamics discussion, landscape 2:1. Original tactile cut-paper/lithographic illustration matching a restrained academic cover: pale ice-blue paper, deep navy #173A5E, muted slate blue, teal #2E6F73, rust coral #A95542. Entirely no text.
Subject: a metaphor for an evolving sampling landscape. A crafted tabletop landscape made of layered paper terraces, with two broad smoothly carved basins and an elevated saddle. In one basin a stack of small thin coral paper deposits partially fills the hollow; the other basin remains open. A single small loosely curled dark navy ribbon rests near the saddle, suggesting a flexible peptide exploring an altered landscape. The stack indicates accumulating bias conceptually, without quantitative height meaning. Render an elegant oblique editorial view; individual grainy paper layers and soft stippled print shadows, balanced composition, generous surrounding space, sophisticated adult science illustration. No gradients, no arrows, no path, no axes, no grids, no numbers, no labels, no equations, no chart frame, no flow diagram, no water, no biological cells, no atomistic structure. This is an explicitly qualitative metaphor, not a computed FES or physical kinetic trajectory.
